auditType: ONE TARGETED INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION - not a broad recertification campaign
centralQuestion: Can ANY OperativeProvisionView with status !== "OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED" reach evidenceCurrent=true (equivalently, evidenceUnresolved: false) through ANY of the CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE text tools?
centralQuestionAnswer: NO - not found through direct code reading of every code path, nor through 18 fresh runtime constructions (all with different section numbers, document/instrument names, amendment wording, and condition wording from every fixture already used by the implementer's own deliverables).

item1_structuralOrderingReadThroughEvery.method: Read lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/tools.ts in full (1033 lines) line by line, plus amendment/operative-state.ts's buildProvisionView/computeOperativeContractState/isConfirmedCurrentOperativeEvidence/resolveOperativeDefinitionEvidence and amendment/chain.ts's buildProvisionChain.
item1_structuralOrderingReadThroughEvery.finding: CONFIRMED - the claim holds, but via TWO distinct, independently-correct mechanisms, not one:
item1_structuralOrderingReadThroughEvery.mechanism1_resolveNodeWithSupersessionAw: tools.ts lines 309-360. `if (view.status !== "OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED") { ...; return { ..., evidenceCurrent: false, ... }; }` is the FIRST branch taken whenever a view exists (line 320), unconditionally returning evidenceCurrent:false regardless of currentText null/non-null. currentText (`currentTextPresent`, computed at line 314) is consulted ONLY inside that branch to choose which text/textSource to LABEL for context (UNRESOLVED_AMENDED_TEXT vs BASE_DOCUMENT_TEXT) - never to flip evidenceCurrent. Only once status===RESOLVED (line 333 onward) does currentText presence select between CASE B (AMENDED_CURRENT_TEXT, evidenceCurrent:true) and CASE C (HISTORICAL_BASE_TEXT, evidenceCurrent:false, clean deletion). Used directly by getParentClause, getSiblingClauses (per-sibling), and both getReferencedProvision resolution paths (absolute-ref and fromNodeId-relative).
item1_structuralOrderingReadThroughEvery.mechanism2_directStatusGates_notThroughT: getOperativeProvision and getRelatedAmendments do NOT call resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness at all - they derive evidenceUnresolved directly as `!isConfirmedCurrentOperativeEvidence(view.status)` (operative-state.ts line 686: `return status === "OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED" || status === "CURRENT_OPERATIVE"`), a status-only check with no currentText branch whatsoever. getDefinition routes through resolveOperativeDefinitionEvidence (operative-state.ts lines 811-865), which dispatches on view.status FIRST (CONFLICTED/PARTIAL/REVIEW_REQUIRED map to non-CURRENT DefinitionEvidenceStatus values at lines 859-863) and only reaches `status = "CURRENT"` in the final else branch - isCurrentTruth is `status === "CURRENT"`, never a currentText truthiness check. getChildren uses its OWN separate resolver, resolveParentSubstructureEvidence (tools.ts lines 392-408), which checks `view.status !== "OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED"` directly (viewBlocksTrust, line 395) and never references currentText at all.
escapeHatchesSearchedForAndNotFound: No early return before the status check in any of the 7 CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE tools (getOperativeProvision, getDefinition, getParentClause, getChildren, getSiblingClauses, getReferencedProvision, getRelatedAmendments).
No CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE-declared tool reads access.structuralIndex directly for its primary text without a status/supersession check first.

getPriorVersion/getContextBundleComponent/getSharedCapContext/getSourceSpan are HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_WITH_STATUS by design (never claim current-truth); getDefinitionDependencies/getInstrumentDocuments/getRuleDependency are NOT_CONTRACT_TEXT_EVIDENCE (never return interpretable provision text) - correctly out of scope for this question, confirmed by reading each execute() body.

item15_cleanControls.scopeNoteOnControlC_designChoice: Control C deliberately uses a never-amended (CASE D) section, not a RESOLVED-amended (CASE B) one, for the full persist-to-VERIFIED path. Direct tracing found that verifyCompiledCandidate (semantic-verification/verify.ts, determineStatus, line ~286) carries its OWN separate, independent gate: `if (sourceInventory.supersessionStatus === "KNOWN_SUPERSEDED") return "REVIEW_REQUIRED"`, keyed off the OLD base physical node that resolveUniqueNodeByRef(sourceSectionRef) finds - which is unconditionally KNOWN_SUPERSEDED for any section that was itself amendment-replaced, regardless of resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness's own (correct) CASE B verdict for that same section. This is a real, pre-existing, intentionally conservative verifier-level mechanism (predates and is orthogonal to the OPEN-2 tools.ts fix under audit here), not an over-blocking regression introduced by this patch. CASE B's own evidenceCurrent=true/evidenceUnresolved=false claim for a RESOLVED-amended section is independently confirmed at both the resolver and tool boundary in Control A above, which is the layer this audit's central question actually concerns.

summary: Every one of the 15 attack angles was attempted with fresh, independently-authored fixtures (different section numbers, document/instrument names, amendment wording, and condition wording from every fixture in docs/open2-final-direct-patch/04-06 and their companion test files). Direct line-by-line reading of the current production code (lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/tools.ts in full, plus the relevant amendment/operative-state.ts and amendment/chain.ts logic) confirms the implementer's structural-ordering claim holds for every one of the 7 CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE-declared tools, via two independently-correct mechanisms (the shared resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness helper for getParentClause/getSiblingClauses/getReferencedProvision, and direct status-only gates for getOperativeProvision/getDefinition/getRelatedAmendments/getChildren). All 18 runtime tests in this audit's own independent test file pass, including 2 full compile->verify->persist->fresh-Postgres-read constructions confirming trustStatus is never VERIFIED for a non-RESOLVED view, and a third full pipeline run confirming a genuinely current provision correctly DOES reach persisted VERIFIED (no over-blocking). tsc and eslint show exactly the documented pre-existing baseline (6 tsc errors / 1 eslint error), 0 new. Broader regression runs (tests/certification: 464/464 passed; tests/contract-model: 1561/1561 passed) show no collateral breakage.
